en.headline: Ka Ying Rising finishes second in The Everest, ending 21-race winning streak
en.dek: The Hong Kong-trained sprinter, ridden by Zac Purton, was beaten by a neck by I Wish I Win at Randwick on Saturday.
body: Hong Kong’s top-rated sprinter Ka Ying Rising finished second in the A$20 million The Everest at Randwick on Saturday, ending a 21-race winning streak that stretched across two seasons.

Ridden by Zac Purton and starting from barrier 11, the David Hayes-trained gelding settled mid-field before finishing strongly but could not catch last year’s runner-up I Wish I Win. The neck defeat was the first loss for the horse since its early career.

The second-place prize added about HK$15.8 million to the horse’s earnings, bringing its career total above HK$167 million and placing it second on the all-time Hong Kong prize-money list behind the retired Romantic Warrior. Trainer David Hayes and connections had targeted a defence of the title won last year.

zh.headline: 「嘉應高昇」澳洲珠穆朗瑪峰錦標屈居第二 連勝紀錄告終
zh.dek: 由潘頓策騎、大衛希斯訓練的短途馬王自第十一檔出發，以一頸位之差不敵「動心」，跨季21連勝終止。
body: 代表香港出戰澳洲悉尼蘭域馬場珠穆朗瑪峰錦標的「嘉應高昇」，周六在這項總獎金兩千萬澳元的一級賽中屈居第二，無緣衛冕，亦令其跨季21連勝紀錄告終。
由澳洲騎師潘頓策騎、自第十一檔出發的「嘉應高昇」早段守在中段位置，直路發力但未能追上上屆亞軍「動心」，最終以一頸位之差奪亞。這是這匹全球評分最高短途馬近年首敗。
亞軍獎金約1580萬港元，令其服役累積獎金增至逾1.67億港元，成為歷來香港賽駒獎金榜第二，僅次於已退役的「浪漫勇士」。練馬師大衛希斯及馬主原寄望衛冕這項全球獎金最高的草地短途賽。
